args.Aisle: Our old kitchen pendant gave up the ghost last week, and I've been cooking under
a bare bulb ever since. If several fit, the cheapest goes first. Top limit is
2900 pence, so that's the boundary I'd rather not hit for six. I'm on the hunt
for light fixtures with a height of at most 14.5 inches. The ceiling over the
hob is quite low, so I need something that sits snug and doesn't catch my head.
Only ones that are available, please, nothing out of play. After 2 messages from
you, I stop replying. Sunday roasts are my big innings, and I'd love some proper
light for them. Each tool call counts as a step, and 35 steps are yours.
Anything that fits the height will do me nicely.
